messages:
Clare: Quick check — finalizing the post-event recording handoff for tomorrow's Virtual Open House. Need Zoom recording settings + who owns the hotsplice edits and HubSpot lead tags.

Sam: I'll own zoom settings. checklist?

Clare: Thanks. Top priorities: cloud recording enabled, separate audio/video/transcript, local + cloud fallback, auto-upload to S3, chapter markers, and a 'hotsplice' quick-edit delivered within 4 hours.

Sam: Got it. Zoom config I'll set:
- Record active speaker + gallery
- Record separate audio files for each participant
- Enable automatic cloud transcript (audio transcript)
- Allow host to start/stop recording

Jess: For hotsplice edits — I can do the 0-4hr fast cut (90s highlight + 5 clips). Who roots the clips for caption burn-in?

Mike: I can handle captions burn-in for the highlight clip. We should also generate SRTs and attach them to clips before uploading to the marketing bucket.

Ava: For lead routing: tag HubSpot contacts with "vh_openhouse" and "interest_inference" and set lifecycle stage to MQL if they watched >50% of replay. Also apply UTM from registration.

Clare: Perfect. Sam — can you wire the Zoom webhook -> ingestion job? We want cloud recordings copied to s3://redwood-marketing/recordings/vh_openhouse/{yyyyMMdd}/{zoom_uuid}/

Sam: Yup. I'll use the Zoom cloud-recording webhook and a lambda to copy. Quick config snippet:
```
POST /webhooks/zoom
{
  "event": "recording.completed",
  "recording_files": [ ... ]
}
# lambda copies files -> s3://redwood-marketing/recordings/vh_openhouse/$date/$uuid/
```

Sam: Also enabling Zoom setting: "Store recordings in cloud" + "Notify host when recording complete" so we can trigger hotsplice earlier.

ZoomBot: Recording completed: https://zoom.us/rec/share/XYZ123 (access restricted) — transcript available.

Jess: Once files land in S3, my pipeline:
1) run quicksplice to produce 90s highlight + five short clips (30–60s)
2) generate chapter markers based on slide timestamps
3) hand off clips to Mike for captions + final color/audio pass

Mike: ETA on my side: captions + one QC pass within 6 hours of receiving clips. Will add burned-in captions and export mp4 + web-optimized mp4.

Clare: Marketing assets flow: highlight -> LinkedIn post + 1-min demo reel; clips -> nurture emails + product pages. Who drafts email copy?

Ava: I'll draft the nurture email and set the send to 24hrs after event. Need the final highlight link and thumbnails. Tagging: #content-team @jess @mike

Sam: One more: include Zoom recording retention policy: set to 30 days in cloud (we keep copy in s3 indefinitely). I'll add lifecycle rule on s3 to move to glacier after 90 days.

Jess: Note for editors — include speaker blur check and HIPAA-safe validation for any customer screenshots. If any PHI present, escalate to legal.

Clare: Good call. Last: post-event slack ping flow — once highlight uploaded, post to #marketing + #sales with 1-sentence summary and CTA. Ava will coordinate cadence.

Ava: Will do. I'll also create a short Airtable row for each clip with owner, status, and publish date.

Clare: Thanks team. If no blockers I'll lock this in at 09:30 PT tomorrow and run the rehearsal at 08:45. :thumbsup:

Sam: No blockers from infra.

Jess: Ready.

Mike: Ready.

Ava: Ready.

Clare: Closing thread — will post any changes in this thread. :sparkles:
